result.summary: All 128 exact states matched and all 128 sampling substreams changed. Global target action agreement was only 0.5469-0.6250, with 15-27 highest-risk-slot disagreements, 10.9%-15.6% cross-replicate regret above 5 bb, and worst-5% regret CVaR 29.15-66.12 bb. SB flop development-selected means reversed negative; BB turn and SB turn remained unstable. BB-flop continuation-CVaR2of3 retained 0.71875 agreement and positive two-way lower95 means but failed the reverse tail gate.
result.conclusion: Do not train from any global 8x8x3 robust target or let positive aggregate means hide cross-replicate action/tail instability.
result.next_step: Use high-sample adaptive resampling on the nine exact unstable BB-flop CVaR rows; otherwise change hidden-state posterior, continuation distribution or target construction.
